# blockchainlab-starters

> Template repo of 14 CI-tested starters built on Blockchains forks: foundry-oz-tokens (ERC-20/721/1155), chainlink-price-feed, uniswap-v4-hook, erc4337-smart-account (+ paymaster), hedera-token-sdk, wagmi-rainbowkit-dapp, circom-zk-proof, noir-zk-proof, subgraph-indexer, ipfs-upload, ccip-crosschain, ai-agent-onchain, farcaster-miniapp and solana-anchor-vault.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [starters/foundry-oz-tokens/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/foundry-oz-tokens/): OpenZeppelin tokens
- [starters/wagmi-rainbowkit-dapp/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/wagmi-rainbowkit-dapp/): dApp front end
- [starters/erc4337-smart-account/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/erc4337-smart-account/): account abstraction
- [starters/subgraph-indexer/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/subgraph-indexer/): The Graph subgraph
- [starters/ipfs-upload/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/ipfs-upload/): IPFS upload on Helia
- [starters/ccip-crosschain/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/ccip-crosschain/): Chainlink CCIP cross-chain
- [starters/ai-agent-onchain/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/ai-agent-onchain/): Grok agent with on-chain tools
- [starters/farcaster-miniapp/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/farcaster-miniapp/): Farcaster Mini App
- [starters/solana-anchor-vault/](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-starters/blob/main/starters/solana-anchor-vault/): Solana Anchor program
